title: Harvest, use-first and loss log
summary: Turn garden output into reliable meals and better planting decisions.
steps: Record crop, bed, date, usable weight or count and visible damage.
Mark what must be eaten first, chilled, frozen, dried or otherwise preserved.
Keep seed-saving produce separate and clearly labelled.
Record storage losses and the reason: heat, moisture, bruising, pests, delay or processing failure.
Use actual edible yield, not planted area, when planning the next cycle.
